lines.text: Many learners say: I studied English during two years.
Better: I studied English for two years.
Use for with a number of years.
For! I lived there for three years.

data.wrong: I studied English during two years.
data.right: I studied English for two years.
data.why: Use for with a number of years.

native.tip: Сколько длилось — “for”: “I studied English for two years.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I studied English during two years”? 😅 По-русски «в течение двух лет» подсказывает слово “during”, но когда называем сколько длилось, по-английски нужен “for.” Правильно: “I studied English for two years.” Послушай Аму и повтори! en.tip: To say how long, use “for”: “I studied English for two years.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I studied English during two years”? 😅 In Russian «в течение» points to “during”, but to say how long, English uses “for.” Correct: “I studied English for two years.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
